accessibility.contrast: Audited twice, by two methods with opposite blind spots. See contrast_method below.
contrast fixes: Page header and filled CTA moved from #008e95 to #006a70. White text on the brighter teal was 3.96:1 and failed AA for the eyebrow, intro and metadata on all seven interior pages; on #006a70 it is 6.37:1.
type-eyebrow text-teal to text-teal-deep. 11px teal is 3.96:1 on white and 3.61:1 on ice.
text-ink-mute to text-ink-soft at 11-12px on the ice ground, where #60747c is 4.46:1.
Button primary hover bg-teal to bg-teal-deep.
Team placeholder initials text-teal/45 to text-teal, 1.8:1 at 52px against a 3:1 requirement.

SECOND PASS, states only: eight hover and group-hover targets still resolving to #008e95 on a light ground, in TeamGrid (3), news/[slug] (3), portfolio/[slug] (2) and the TextLink teal tone. All moved to teal-deep, or to ink where the resting colour was already teal-deep.
keyboard: Homepage Active/Exits filter had role=tablist with none of the pattern implemented. Now uses the shared useTablist: roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home/End, aria-labelledby on the panel. Verified ArrowLeft from Exits returns to Active and repopulates 14 companies.
Mobile menu closes on Escape and returns focus to the toggle. Verified.
Mobile menu closes on route change. Previously it outlived the page it opened on.
Skip link added; moves focus to main, which now carries tabIndex -1.
accessibility.responsive: No horizontal overflow at 320, 360, 375, 430, 768, 1024 or 1440. Header verified at 320px: logo 180x60, wordmark not compressed, menu button 46px, 46px gap.

contrast_method.live sweep: Resolved every text colour and its effective background on a canvas across ten rendered pages. Catches real element/ground pairings. BLIND TO EVERY STATE: hover, focus, and anything that only exists after an interaction were never visited, because it samples resting computed styles.
contrast_method.static sweep: Reads the built stylesheet and checks every emitted colour utility, including hover:, focus: and group-hover/x: variants, against each light ground. Catches states. OVER-REPORTS, because it does not know which ground a given class actually lands on.
contrast_method.why both: The first pass used only the live sweep and reported zero failures. That was wrong. Eight hover-state failures were live at the time and the sweep could not see any of them by construction.

contrast_result.hover and focus states: 0 failures; every emitted colour utility that can land on a light ground clears 4.5:1, except the cases listed under exempt below
exempt, verified individually: text-teal on the 52px team initials: large text, 3.96:1 against a 3:1 requirement
text-teal on the decorative plates and arrow glyphs: non-text, 3.96:1 against a 3:1 requirement
text-ink-mute: flagged by the static sweep against the ice ground, but all eleven call sites were enumerated and every one is either on white (4.90:1) or wraps an Arrow icon rather than text

robustness.RouteTransition: Removed the whole-page opacity fade. Every page body was gated behind a JS-driven opacity animation, so a throttled frame loop left the site blank; reproduced during this pass. It also hid the LCP element for 520ms on first paint. The teal hairline sweep is kept.
robustness.ScientificBackground: Deleted. A canvas particle field with its own rAF loop, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver and a window-level pointermove listener, running on six pages.
robustness.TeamGrid: The close-cleanup put inert on the dialog but not on the backdrop. AnimatePresence holds both mounted for the exit, so with the frame loop starved the exit never completes and a fixed inset-0 overlay stays at opacity 0 across the whole viewport, swallowing every click while the page looks completely normal. Keyboard was already covered by the dialog inert; this was the pointer path. Fixed with inert plus pointerEvents none on the backdrop ref, both undone on reopen. REPRODUCED AND MEASURED: with rAF stubbed and the panel dismissed, elementFromPoint at three points returned the backdrop before the fix and the real page content after it.

Real-device testing. All responsive checks were emulated viewports in Chrome.
Google sitelink selection. Crawlable URLs, titles and internal links are in place; selection is Google’s and cannot be guaranteed by site code.

Post-interaction contrast was not measured by the live sweep at all. The contact confirmation panel, the open team dialog and the form error and rate-limit alerts only exist after an interaction, so a crawl of prerendered HTML cannot reach them. The static sweep over the built stylesheet covers the colours those states use, which is why it was added, but their layout and composition were not audited.

The two remaining hover:text-teal instances at the time of writing were in app/contact/page.tsx and components/ui/ContactForm.tsx, outside this session’s file ownership. They were reported to the session that owns them rather than edited here.
corrections: An earlier version of this record claimed zero contrast failures. It was produced by the live resting-state sweep only, and was wrong: eight hover-state failures were live, plus two in files owned by the parallel session. Both were found after a peer challenged the claim. The record now states the method and its blind spot rather than the bare result.
